texts: Traveler, your footprints are the way and nothing more; traveler, there is no way, the way is made by walking.
Traveler, your footprints are the way and nothing more; Traveler, there is no road, the way is made by walking.
Traveler, your footprints are the way and nothing more; traveler, there is no way, you make the way as you walk.
Traveler, your footprints are the way and nothing more; traveler, there is no way, you make a way as you go.
